🖥 Poster of 1st International Festival of Nima Yushij unveiled

📌 Sari, IRNA – The poster for the International Festival of Nima Youshij, dedicated to cultural, artistic, and literary studies, has been unveiled ahead of the event, set to take place November 17–19 at the University of Mazandaran in northern Iran.

The opening ceremony of the secretariat of the First International Nima Youshij Festival and the unveiling of the festival’s logo will also be held on Monday, October 5, 2026, at the University of Mazandaran.
​
This ceremony will take place with the presence of a number of officials, professors, and enthusiasts.
​
The First International Nima Youshij Festival is being held with a focus on cultural, artistic, and literary studies in the works of Nima Youshij, the father of modern Persian poetry.
​
Cultural and social studies, artistic studies, literary criticism, modern and classical poetry, Mazandarani poetry, and literary schools are among the axes of the scientific section of this festival.
​
In the cultural and artistic section, works in the fields of theater, local music, photography, painting, calligraphy, and visual arts will be accepted.
​
The deadline for submitting works to the festival secretariat has been announced as October 7, 2026.
​
The festival will be held on November 17-19, 2026, at the University of Mazandaran in Babolsar.
​
Those interested in submitting works, coordinating, and obtaining more information can contact the festival secretariat via social media, as well as the festival’s Instagram page.

🔻 Iran army chief hails police endeavors to maintain security

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Army Chief General Amir Hatami has praised the round-the-clock efforts of police personnel, saying that sustainable security and the protection of public peace are indebted to the strong presence and sacrifices of polices forces.

In a message marking Police Week on Sunday, Hatami praised the dedicated efforts of Iran’s Law Enforcement Command (FARAJA in Persian) personnel in maintaining order and security and safeguarding public peace.
​
He stressed that sustainable security and social peace are undoubtedly indebted to the sacrifice and efforts of men and women who, across the country, stand ready to serve under the most difficult conditions and in the face of various threats and challenges.
​
The army chief added that police martyrs had demonstrated the highest forms of sacrifice, loyalty and service to the people and the country by giving their lives on this path.
​
The commander also highlighted FARAJA’s efforts to enhance intelligence capabilities and operational awareness, make use of new technologies, and update methods for combating crimes and emerging threats.

Macklemore speaks in a pre-recorded video at the Power to the People festival: “To me, power to the people means exactly that. Real change has always come from people organizing, resisting, and refusing to accept the world as it is. Right now, there is a genocide happening in Gaza, there is a genocide happening in Sudan, there is immeasurable suffering in the Congo where kids are working in cobalt mines to give us cobalt for our smartphones and electric cars. I believe that resistance means seeing ourselves in all oppressed peoples as brothers and sisters in a global community and using our collective power to end these atrocities. History has shown us that those in power rarely hand over freedom willingly. Liberation has always required people to organize and demand it. None of us are free until all of us are free. I wish I could be there tonight, much love to Tom and everybody else in the building, and last but not least, Free Palestine until it’s backwards.”

يتحدث ماكلمور في فيديو مسجل مسبقاً في مهرجان "السلطة للشعب" (Power to the People):
"بالنسبة لي، عبارة 'السلطة للشعب' تعني ذلك حرفياً. التغيير الحقيقي جاء دائماً من تنظيم الناس، ومقاومتهم، ورفضهم قبول العالم على ما هو عليه. في الوقت الحالي، هناك إبادة جماعية تحدث في غزة، وهناك إبادة جماعية تحدث في السودان، وهناك معاناة لا توصف في الكونغو حيث يعمل الأطفال في مناجم الكوبالت ليزودونا بالكوبالت من أجل هواتفنا الذكية وسياراتنا الكهربائية. أنا أؤمن بأن المقاومة تعني أن نرى أنفسنا في كل الشعوب المضطهدة كإخوة وأخوات في مجتمع عالمي، وأن نستخدم قوتنا الجماعية لوضع حد لهذه الفظائع. لقد أظهر لنا التاريخ أن أولئك الذين يمسكون بالسلطة نادراً ما يتنازلون عن الحرية عن طيب خاطر. لقد تطلب التحرر دائماً من الناس أن ينظموا صفوفهم ويطالبوا بها. لا أحد منا بحرية حتى يكون الجميع أحراراً. أتمنى لو أستطيع أن أكون معكم الليلة، تحياتي الكثيرة لـ توم ولجميع المتواجدين في القاعة، وأخيراً وليس آخراً: فلسطين حرة حتى التحرير."
